filler_sample: Keith, thanks for that, it means a lot. I'm alright, keeping my chin up. Wouldn't mind a chat when you've a minute — and if you hear of anything going at the bakery or the shops, give me a shout. Megan

Hiya Lewis, hope you're well. Just checking in about Saturday work at the Food Hall if you've got any shifts going. I'd be grateful for a yes or no whenever you get a minute. Hope the stall's keeping you busy x
Morning Dave, could we have a quick word about my hours over the next few weeks? I'm trying to get the car sorted by Saturday and the bills are tight. Happy to work around whatever suits the shop.

Keith, sorry for the delay. Pete can have a trial early shift on Saturday, I'm not sure what I can stretch to yet so let's say $12 an hour for the early shifts and we'll see how the numbers look after Monday's delivery. Tell him I'm sorry it's not more definite. Alan

Hiya love, sorry I've been so quiet, the shop's been mad and I didn't want to say anything half-baked. The car's gone for brakes and a tyre, $460, which comes out of our account when I collect it Saturday. I know that leaves us tight, and I'm sorry. Let's sit down tonight and go through the week's money properly, I think we can manage if we're careful with food. Love you x

Owen — thanks. Own-brand rice, pasta, tinned toms is what I want. Text me the numbers when you're on shift: price per item and any multi-buy. I'm trying to get our food spend down to $80 a week, so I need the figures to plan the list. Corner Stores is steady — Dave's watching the till like a hawk, as ever. Craig

Megan, love, no need to apologise. I'm a bit tied up this weekend with the shop and the money side at home, so let's not make it a weekend thing. Thursday at the Plough? Pint's on me, and we can have a proper catch-up. Alan x

Morning love! 10 is perfect, I'll be ready. I know, the car bill is nagging at me too, so I'll keep the shop list tight. Could we sit down with the household figures once we're back? Sorry, I know I'm fretting x

Dave, Pete Bevan. Two figures in writing from you Monday: your message says Saturdays 10-1 at $18/hr, but the accepted request r102 says $14/hr for Saturday early and Friday orders. I can't work off two rates. Send me one line confirming the rate — and if it's $18, the rota entry needs correcting to match. Also Friday ordering: you said you'd confirm in writing once squared with Alan. I need that too. Thanks.
Maureen, glad it's sorted. Nine sharp Saturday, back door. Nothing much to know — wear the fleece, the shelves are dusty and the till's got a mind of its own. I'll walk you through it. See you then.
Hiya love, got your message, thanks for telling me straight. Don't worry about the car, we'll sort it. Let's sit down tonight and go through the money properly, I'll put the kettle on. Love you x

Lewis, thanks so much, nine sharp Saturday at the back door works a treat. I'll wear my old fleece, I expect it'll get mucky. Looking forward to learning the shelves and the till. Anything I should know before I start? x
Yeah, tonight after tea works. Let's do it properly, line by line, before we even think about borrowing. I'll have my notes ready.
Keith, you about this weekend? Is the bakery taking anyone on at the moment? I'm after work, anything going. Cheers.
Maureen — straight answer: money's tight but I could use a pair of hands Saturdays. Not promising anything till I've looked at the wage bill this week. I'll come back to you Monday. Lewis

Megan, lovely to hear from you, and I'm sorry about the job, that's a rotten thing to have happen. Come by this afternoon, I'd love to see you. Bring the paperwork and we'll go through your sums properly, no rush. Put the kettle on at mine, and don't you dare worry about the cake. Sian x
Gary, nothing from the bakery yet, it's been quiet. Have a word with Pete Bevan at Quarry Road Food Hall, he might know of something going. Keith

Dear Craig, thank you for getting in touch about the car loan. I understand money is tight at the moment. I can't promise anything over message, but I'd like to look at your account properly with you. Could you come into the branch early next week? Bring any recent pay slips and your current outgoings so we can see what options the bank can offer. Kind regards, Sian

Maureen — sorry for the delay, week ran away with me. Yes, let's do it: come in this Saturday and we'll see how the day goes. If it works for both of us we'll make it regular. Pete's in too so you won't be thrown in alone. What time can you start?
Gary, not heard of anything at the bakery, Alan's cut back since Christmas, sorry. Ask Pete Bevan, he's been asking around too. I'll keep my ears open.
Yeah, I'll be home for tea. We'll go through the budget properly tonight, bills and food line by line. Rent's $25 more so we need about $25 a week back from somewhere.

Sian love, it's Megan! Sorry I've been quiet, it's been a week of it. I'd love that cuppa — I can come by this afternoon if that suits? I'll bring a cake, a lemon one I think. I've the benefit paperwork and my sums to go through with you, I'm about $140 a week down now the job's gone and I want to know what I'm entitled to. See you later, and thanks love x
Alright Lewis! Any chance you've got weekend shifts going at Quarry Road? I could do with some extra money coming in, and I'm happy to work the weekend rush. Let me know, ta!

Hi Owen, sorry for the slow reply. I'm still working out the figures for the new rent and I'd rather not give you a number I'm not sure of. I'll come back to you properly this week, and I'm sorry for keeping you waiting. Alan

Pete — Dales lorry is off the road, no delivery this week. I've put a run in with Brook for Monday. When it lands, count every box against the docket before you sign. They come up short sometimes and I want it logged same day.

Dave, Craig. Following our talk: Pete — $22/hr, 8-hour shifts, early mornings plus Saturday. I've told Pete nothing's agreed till it's on paper, so I need that in writing from you — an offer letter or even a note signed with the rate and hours on it. Can you have it to me today or Monday? I'm not promising him hours off the back of a conversation.
Maureen — 9am back door, that's what we agreed and that's what stands. 8's no good, I won't be up. Lewis
Hi Megan, lovely to hear from you. I can do this afternoon, so shall we say about 2 o'clock? Bring the paperwork and we'll make a proper cuppa of it. No rush at all. Sian x
Dave, Pete Bevan's coming in about half one — he's after weekend orders and early Saturday, the shifts nobody wants. He's reliable, he'll turn up. Worth a word on the rate with him direct.
Megan — $40 standing order is set, goes out same day each week. $720 left at $40 a week is 18 weeks. I'll keep it going. Craig

Hi Sian — Tuesday half nine at the branch, I'll be there. I'll bring the figures and the loan details, and yes let's talk about the rent too, I'm still chasing Alan for his new number. Thanks for fitting me in!
Hi Craig, yes the $40 came through fine on Saturday, so $720 left. Thanks for keeping it going — same again this week and we're grand. Megan
Hi Maureen, Owen at Quarry Road — just checking you're still alright for Saturday nine o'clock? Lewis is off sick all week so I'm holding the fort. Let me know if anything's changed.

Alan, Pete Bevan's asking for Saturday or early morning shifts. He's at the Food Hall on $96 a week and needs more hours. Would you consider a trial shift? And what's the rate for extra shifts? I'll pass it on to him tonight. Keith

Megan, Craig. $40 off the $800 today, bank transfer. I'll keep chipping at it weekly — $40 a week where I can, more when the car loan's sorted. Figures first, promises second, so I'm only saying what I can hold to. Thanks for being patient.

Sian, Craig Pryce here. Wanted a word about the car loan — $4,000 at $43 a week. Money's tight and I'm trying to get weekly spend under $790. Is there any room to stretch the term or trim the rate? Happy to come into the branch.
Lewis, sorry, my mistake, I did say 8. Shall I come to the back door at 8 on Saturday? Let me know if that still works for you. Maureen x

Dave, Craig. Still waiting on the hourly rate for Pete Bevan — weekend orders and early Saturday shifts. He's keen and he's reliable, and I'd vouch for him, but I'm not putting his name forward without a figure on it. Can you confirm the rate today? Craig

Pete, Craig. Dave's put it in writing, so here it is straight: your rate is $12 an hour, but it's Saturday only — the ordering shift and early Saturday — and only if trade holds. He's not promising Friday nights. If you want the Friday ordering as well, that means talking about a lower rate, because the margin won't carry it. That's his words, not mine. I'm seeing him at four today and I'll push for it in writing on the rota.

Keith, Pete. Thanks for the Alan update. A Saturday trial at $12/hr — I'll take it if it firms up Monday. Let me know the moment you hear. If he wants me earlier in the week for a look round, say the word.
